introHtml: Embroidery adds a textured, durable finish to badge ID holders that stands up to daily wear in industrial or uniformed settings. Unlike printed holders, embroidered logos won't peel or fade, making them ideal for safety managers and HR directors equipping teams with long-lasting identification. Choose from nylon or polyester webbing with full-color stitched emblems for a polished, professional appearance that reinforces brand consistency across your workforce.
